pos.personaBrief: Coaches' Voice 2021: Palmeiras does not take the initiative permanently, is practical and adapts; vertical transitions are a trademark and a mid-block waits.

pro.personaBrief: Vertical transitions behind the last line, direct ball to forwards as an option and long balls to contest second balls (TFA), though short touches to draw pressure are also used.

est.personaBrief: Zonal, position-oriented, organised shape with wing-backs holding width and a fixed structure in each phase (TFA, Coaches' Voice).

lar.personaBrief: Build-up escapes via the wings, wing-backs create overloads, and Abel asked for width on the flank in 2023; yet the wide attackers are pushed inside in the 3-4-3.

blo.personaBrief: Mid-block, passive until the halfway line, with perde-pressiona after losing the ball in attack and high individual pressing at goal kicks; the centre-forward only cuts passing lanes.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal, position-oriented marking in open play (TFA), with individual references in pressing and specific roles against dangerous opponents (Scarpa vs Isla).

pla.personaBrief: Varied the initial shape and phases, made tactical adjustments by opponent (Flamengo final, Cuca 2022, 2023 width fix), and prepares via numerical relations.

res.personaBrief: Practicality and results first: titles, set-piece goals, closing games with fewer players, and a 'train to play and play to win' stance.

sis.personaBrief: Collective discipline and shared tactical roles, with wingers' duels created by positional advantage; a demanding 'not Big Brother' meritocracy for everyone.

jog.personaBrief: Intense, disciplined, practical team, strong in duels, second balls and set pieces; 'maxima forca' stated in 2023.

bas.personaBrief: Record 24 academy players used in 2021 and a formative-coach essence, but he stresses merit, no space for everyone, and won titles with experienced squads.

lid.personaBrief: Demanding, intense and strict ('confundem arrogancia com competencia'), discipline inside and outside the pitch, merit-based, decisions by the staff.
